cues.text: So which price is the real one?
Every tower, floor and unit sits in one grid, each with its own price.
Book a unit and it locks, so a second agent cannot sell it.
Each booking runs from Token to Agreement to Registered, with milestones attached.
The dashboard counts the same units, so nobody retypes a number.
Reports show units left and booking value for every project you sell.
One inventory. One price. Live. Book a live demo.
